The force override is now allowed on all surfaces (library, CLI, MCP), with auditability enforced by absence of signed attestation rather than withholding capability from MCP.
CI pipelines can block forced writes by checking for missing certification/attestation, replacing the prior CLI-only withholding model.
MCP docstrings in _mcp_writes.py already correctly describe the absent-attestation audit model; documentation prose must align with this shipped implementation.
The two stale passages must be rewritten without touching code, tests, MCP docstrings, or out-of-scope CLI-only statements (secret-pattern override, bridge setup wizard).
